annotations.title: Look up how an article is licensed

description: Looks up an article on Opedd by its web address. Returns the title, publication and how to license it (pay-per-answer search or a licence order); for a publication's homepage, the publication and its licensing page; or that it is not on Opedd yet (then request_publication records the request).

url.description: The canonical URL of the article or content to look up
